task.title: Memory cleanup accepts one provably missing outer JSON delimiter
task.source: Direct user report plus repeated live Harlequin reproductions on the Raspberry Pi.

coreClaim: Structured generation accepts a response only when adding one missing outer JSON delimiter yields valid schema-conforming data, while genuinely cut-off or malformed output still fails or enters bounded repair.
rootCause: Live LinkAPI Gemini repeatedly returned a complete proposals array but omitted the enclosing object's final brace while reporting finishReason=stop. Re-requesting the same repair reproduced the identical provider formatting defect.

inScope: Conservative single-delimiter EOF completion in shared structured generation
Focused positive and negative regression coverage
outOfScope: Memory candidate selection, persistence, or cleanup apply behavior
Chat, roleplay, or game generation prompts

claimBoundary.coreClaim: A Harlequin cleanup response missing only its outer closing brace is parsed after one conservative delimiter closure and must still pass the exact response schema and proposal validator.
entrypoints: Character Memories -> Tidy memories -> Analyze memories
legacyPathsOrFormats: Providers that ignore responseFormat still receive the exact JSON proposal schema in prompt text.
Providers that do not support adjustable reasoning still receive the larger output budget.
Valid fenced JSON with trailing provider text remains accepted.
Proposal validation and review-before-apply behavior remain unchanged.
positiveRowsTested: Existing valid fenced JSON proposal with trailing text
Two malformed responses followed by a valid bounded repair response
One missing outer delimiter followed by a complete nested value
One complete live ten-group Harlequin cleanup replay
negativeRowsTested: Unrelated memories excluded from the model request
A response cut off inside a string is not completed
A response missing more than one delimiter is not completed
Malformed or schema-invalid JSON never reaches proposal normalization
groundTruthFacts: The failing live response had finishReason=length, 1,148 thought tokens, and 48 candidate tokens under the 1,200-token cap.
A post-deploy live response had finishReason=stop but ended mid-object at character 874.
The current live failure repeated three times with finishReason=stop, a closed proposals array, and only the outer object brace missing.
The patched full replay analyzed all ten live groups, accepted one narrowly repairable response, and produced six review proposals without applying anything.
claimBoundary.userActionCopy: No new user action or copy is introduced.
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not alter which memories are selected as cleanup candidates.
This change does not bypass validation or apply any proposal automatically.
This change does not claim every provider will honor no-reasoning parameters.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: A provider could finish a semantically complete object with exactly one outer delimiter missing, then reproduce the same formatting defect on every repair request.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Structured generation may recover only syntax that is mechanically unambiguous and must still enforce the caller's schema before returning success.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The parser considers a single EOF delimiter only when strings are closed, delimiters are otherwise balanced, the response ends with a complete object or array, and the completed JSON passes the exact Zod schema.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: Mode-neutral engine generation owns memory cleanup prompt semantics and request parameters.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not infer missing strings or values, balance multiple unknown structures, loosen schema or proposal validation, or apply anything before review.
regressionProof: src/engine/generation/structured-generation.spec.ts proves one missing outer delimiter is accepted without another LLM call.
The paired negative regression proves output cut off inside a string remains rejected.
The live Harlequin replay completed all ten groups with one raw parse failure and six preview proposals; no apply command was issued.

positiveRows.claim: The focused memory cleanup behavior remains correct.
positiveRows.evidence: The cleanup and structured-generation suites passed 18 tests, including single-delimiter EOF completion, cut-off-string and multiple-delimiter rejection, repeated malformed responses, and strict proposal validation.

positiveRows.claim: The complete live analysis path can produce a safe preview.
positiveRows.evidence: A sanitized full replay analyzed all ten Harlequin groups, safely completed the one raw response missing its outer brace, and returned six preview proposals; no apply command was issued.

positiveRows.claim: The TypeScript and architecture boundaries remain valid.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm typecheck and pnpm check:architecture passed in the isolated worktree.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not invent missing content.
contradictionRows.evidence: Only one unmatched outer container may be closed, strings must already be complete, delimiter nesting must otherwise match, and the result must parse and satisfy the caller's schema.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not alter memory records during analysis.
contradictionRows.evidence: Only shared structured parsing and its focused tests changed; storage and apply paths are untouched.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Providers that already returned valid JSON continue through the same parser and validator.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Existing valid JSON and fenced JSON with trailing provider text regression tests still pass without a repair request.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Providers that ignore JSON mode still receive a complete textual schema.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT includes exact keep_one, combine, and conflict object shapes and exact reason strings.

untestedRows: The complete Harlequin browser flow will be rechecked after this build is deployed to the Pi; no proposal will be applied.

ownedFacts.description: Memory cleanup analysis is owned by the TypeScript engine and uses the shared LLM gateway without changing provider transport.
ownedFacts.evidence: src/engine/generation/memory-cleanup.ts imports only engine contracts, entities, and the LlmGateway capability.

ownedFacts.description: The existing validator requires sourceIds, a replacement object for combine proposals, and enumerated reason strings.

verification.baselineEvidence: pnpm check passed: deterministic repository gates, TypeScript, architecture, docs, Pi distribution, Rust workspace check, and the warning-only unused-code report. Focused structured-generation and memory-cleanup suites passed 18 tests.

notes: No user memory content is recorded in this ledger.
The PR remains unmerged until local checks, hosted CI, current-head Bunny, and PR health are clean.
